tactics:
induction p with
  | nil => simp [Nat.Internal.Linear.Poly.isNonZero]
  | cons kv p ih => cases kv; simp_all [Nat.Internal.Linear.Poly.isNonZero, Nat.Internal.Linear.Poly.denote]; split <;> simp_all <;> omega
